notes.title: Hotfix v25.3.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix SAVAGE (+1 Inno on oppo <=60pts) not triggering on loss
[*] Fix exploit allowing you to skip board meetings
[*] Fix peak strength tracking to count bonuses, and only count when a game is played
[*] Fix streak-based traits being disrupted by pre-GF bye
[*] Fix position MID > C in CONTROL THE TEMPO tactic
[*] Fix invisible Magnificence tooltip claiming mouse input
[*] Fix tactic name "Let Them Cook" in mixed leagues
[*] Fix for main menu label saying FINALS when it's really Round 7
[*] Possible fix for "Network Error" when uploading large save files via Feedback
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v25.3.7

[*] [DLC] Fix missing career years for players tracking Brisbane Bears 1993-1996

notes.title: Modern Eras DLC: 1990s, 2000s, 2010s
notes.content: [p][b]Squiggle Football: Modern Eras[/b] is a small DLC that adds over 2,500 new players to the base game, each statistically modelled on real careers from the 1990s, 2000s, and 2010s.[/p][p]Unlocked 100% of the Deck in the base game? Then it's time to expand your horizons.[/p][p]Configure runs to draw players from a specific Era, or the entire pool.[/p][p align="start"]This DLC pack does not alter gameplay.[/p][p]Available now from the Steam Store.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting Squiggle Football![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176042/86e23da7e275cf2743667045506b1d45c1ec218a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 25.3.x: State of the Nation
notes.content: [h3]What's New (v25.2.10 -> v25.3.6):[/h3][list][*][p]Australian state selector in "Create New Team"[/p][/*][*][p]Oppo team place names reflect the appropriate Australian state in State & Bush leagues[/p][/*][*][p]Add 3 x new 2025 debutants[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Deck bug that could unlock players incorrectly when their "Plays Like" counterpart played for multiple teams[/p][/*][*][p]Fix confetti animation timing on Grand Final win choking your GPU[/p][/*][*][p]Fix AutoPlace suggesting the wrong draftee (Can still happen if your team has very unbalanced OFF / MID / DEF)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix AutoPlace using bench spots invalidated by FOCUSED or SINGULAR trait[/p][/*][*][p]Fix AutoPlace shifting all 3 draftees to the Bench rather than leaving them in the Tray[/p][/*][*][p]Fix exploit that could allow you to avoid being terminated even though you totally deserved it[/p][/*][*][p]Fix exploit that could dodge FOCUSED and SINGULAR penalties (limited bench space)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix invalid team data causing hang on Load Game screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fix drafting in post-season before START button is clicked[/p][/*][*][p]Fix DELIST button popping up during AutoPlace + Future Preview[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Deck unlock cards being partially hidden when clicking[/p][/*][*][p]Escape key / "close" action now exits keyboard navigation loop that can occur if app loses focus during a keyboard operation[/p][/*][*][p]Load Game screen shows Magnificence levels[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176042/2ab699304413ec6bf398cb318a6ba88b2dbe7502.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 25.2.x: Thanks For Your Inputs
notes.content: [p]Thanks for being part of Squiggle Football's launch! It's been a wild couple of weeks. Here's the first patch, aimed at addressing the most commonly requested features (input bindings) and issues (semi-broken Endless mode). -- Max.[/p][h3]What's New (v25.1.2 -> v25.2.9):[/h3][list][*][p]Input bindings! You can now remap keyboard shortcuts[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support![/p][/*][*][p]Layout change: Team Analysis topbar no longer takes up full screen width to provide more room for right-hand panel[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug preventing National League teams from receiving coach bonuses after season 7 or 8[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug that could prevent National League teams from filling their lists after a few seasons[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug that could temporarily halt progress when dismissing all recruits after winning a semi-final[/p][/*][*][p]Fix oppo team history showing wrong colours[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Magnificence level 10 refusing to unlock[/p][/*][*][p]Fix UI import/export issues including displaying wrong save date for Auto-Backups on Windows[/p][/*][*][p]Fix link to Steam DLC page[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: Opposition team strength scales up more quickly upon winning each successive National flag after your first[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: The worst team in each league is now slightly worse, to provide a clear bottom team[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: Increase mid-season recruit quality available to National league opposition teams[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: Increase internal value of "Unforgiving" (+2 Inno on Delist) from 4 -> 8 (which means it will be paired with 4 lower coach bonus to OFF/DEF/MID)[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: Increase internal value of "Decelerate" from 6 -> 8[/p][/*][*][p]"Decelerate" can now only be applied once per player[/p][/*][*][p]UI changes to prevent enthusiastic clicking / spacebarring from confirming retirement after winning a National League flag[/p][/*][*][p]Add comma separator to large score numbers[/p][/*][*][p]Allow skipping of Board animations on click / spacebar[/p][/*][*][p]Coaches can no longer simultaneously offer both "Inclusive" (+1 Coach option) and "Skeptical" (-1 Coach option)[/p][/*][*][p]Add penalty for playing a game with no Gameplan[/p][/*][*][p]Add text in Feedback directing people to Discord if they have questions that need answers[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Issues?[/b] Find answers in the [url="https://discord.gg/MprJNDTD9n"]Squiggle Discord[/url]. [/p][p][b]Need backups?[/b] You can find your auto-backups in "Options" from the game's main menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176042/07e8390ea20805dff0f559da270d4a9d61bdbc9b.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: BWAAAARP
notes.content: [h3]You can't develop a game all by yourself, they said. The market for video games based on Australian Rules Football is too small, they said. Don't you have a real job you're supposed to be doing, they said. Well HA! Check it out![/h3][h2]Game Launch[/h2][p]On Aug 14, 2025, the game is now live on PC, Mac, Linux.[/p][p]This has been a ton of fun to develop. [/p][p]Please show your support by buying the game, playing the demo, or wishlisting! And tell your friends.[/p][h3]Special Thanks[/h3][p]This game has had exactly 1 play-tester, my friend Wild Pete. I just checked and he has 208 hours played. So either he's very dedicated or he really likes the game. Maybe both. Thanks Wild Pete! I made lots of great changes thanks to your constant criticism.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176042/3254e2d3fdceeed715f14b6a833238267d2bcdff.png"][/img][/p]
